name: rating
title: Rating
description: Pick a score from a row of stars, whole or half, with a preview as the pointer moves.

files.content:
Default

Five stars, whole steps.

Half stars

data-step="0.5" lets the pointer and the arrow keys pick halves.

Deselectable

A press on the checked star clears the score.

Read-only

Shows any score, such as 4.2, as one labelled image.

4.2

Disabled

Not focusable, and not submitted.

Controlled

Set the score from outside, and listen for changes.

    Form

    Required, submitted under a name, and reset.

    How was your experience?

    Stars and labels

    More stars, wrapping arrows and a custom label.

    7 / 10

    Sizes

    Small, default and large.

    Custom icon

    Put any icon in a <template> inside the rating.
